::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**Schedule update (September 29).** ANOVA has been removed from the course. Correlation moves up to Session 8 (October 6, with midterm review), the midterm stays at Session 9 (October 13), regression is Session 10 (October 20), logistic regression is Session 11 (November 10), and presentations are Session 12 (December 1). **No class October 27, November 3, November 17, or November 24.** Session dates are on the [syllabus calendar](syllabus.qmd).
:::

Readings are due **before** the start of the listed class session. "R4DS" = [*R for Data Science*, 2nd ed.](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) (free online). Slide, lab, and homework links go live as each session is published.
